metadata.title: A curvature-ellipse-based Monge normal form of a regular surface in $\mathbb{R}^4$ and its applications
metadata.abstract: We study a Monge normal form of a surface in $\mathbb{R}^4$ based on the principal axes of its curvature ellipse. The curvature-ellipse-based Monge normal form is obtained using only Euclidean motions of the ambient space and local reparameterizations of the surface, and preserves the Euclidean invariants of the curvature ellipse, including its semi-axis lengths up to their ordering. We also give applications of this normal form to the $2$-jet geometry of surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^4$ and to the geometry of their orthogonal projections.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: R⁴ surface 的 curvature ellipse Monge form
analysis.workSummary: 通过 Euclidean motion 与参数变换将 Monge form 对齐 curvature ellipse 的 principal axes，保持无序 semiaxis 并用于 projection 的二阶几何。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供与外在曲率 ellipse 相容的规范表达。
analysis.limitations: 规范化使用 Euclidean 而非任意 affine transformation，轴的顺序不构成不变量。
